preconditions: Include healthy success controls and at least one non-performance command compatibility control using only existing command seams and deterministic fixtures.
expected_behavior: Assert the exact theories covered by exercising representative performance commands and checking stable JSON envelope fields, text output, stdout/stderr separation, and success, target-miss, cancellation, partial, and operational-failure exit mappings. The test supports promotion readiness and must not be presented as proof that coverage was previously absent.
